content.title: Validate URL-driven dashboard filtering
content.description:
Validate the URL-driven dashboard filtering meets the requirements.

Verify:
- Default view (no URL params) shows 'Open' issues only (todo, in-progress, done) — NOT idea or closed.
- Selecting 'Idea' shows only idea issues; selecting 'Closed' shows only closed.
- Changing status, search, and assignee controls updates the URL params correctly.
- Loading a bookmarked URL with params applies the expected filters.
- Clearing filters returns to the default 'Open' state in the URL.
- Typecheck, lint, and existing tests pass; add component/E2E coverage for the param-driven behavior.

Report quality metrics. Do not fix bugs — report them back.

content.reason: Blocker issue mqguhco4qj transitioned to done

content.content:
Validation complete. URL-driven dashboard filtering MEETS all requirements.

## Requirements verified (all PASS)
- Default view (no URL params) shows Open issues only (todo, in-progress, done); idea and closed are excluded. Backend 'open' meta-status returns todo/in-progress/done/idea, and the frontend filters out idea client-side (api/issues.ts). URL stays clean with no status param.
- Selecting Idea / Closed / Todo writes the corresponding ?status= value to the URL and shows only those issues.
- Changing status, search, and assignee controls updates the URL params (search is debounced ~250ms).
- Bookmarking a URL with params applies the expected filters on load (verified for status, combined status+search, and status reflected in the dropdown).
- Clearing filters strips all params and returns to the default Open state in the URL.

## Tests added
- New E2E spec: packages/webapp/e2e/url-filters-validation.spec.ts (12 tests covering default view, deep-linking, control→URL sync, and clear-filters). All 12 pass.
- No component/unit test framework exists in the webapp today (only E2E), so coverage was added at the E2E layer.

## Quality metrics
- Frontend build/typecheck (tsc -b + vite build): PASS.
- No lint script is configured in the webapp (none found) — typecheck is the only static gate.
- Full E2E suite: 170 passed, 4 failed.
- The 4 failures are PRE-EXISTING and UNRELATED to URL filtering: they are the phase4 BUG-2 sync tests that assert the old buggy .toBe(500). They now fail because sync push/pull returns 200 instead of 500, which strongly suggests BUG-2 (mqe162svv5) has been fixed and those tests are now stale (they need updating to assert 200 and verify end-to-end sync behavior). Flagging for the PM to route back to webapp-developer.

## Defect found (reported separately)
- Created idea mqgxk7rj2a: the Status filter dropdown trigger displays raw status values ('closed', 'in-progress') instead of the human-readable labels ('Closed', 'In Progress'). Cosmetic only; filtering works correctly.

## Minor note (not a spec violation)
- useSearchParams uses { replace: false } for every filter change, so debounced search typing pushes many history entries (back button needs several clicks to leave). Tracking as an observation, not blocking.

Done. The validation work for URL-driven dashboard filtering was performed by webapp-validator (see their report above). All requirements PASS:

- Default view shows Open issues only (todo/in-progress/done); idea and closed excluded. PASS
- Idea / Closed / Todo filters write correct ?status= values. PASS
- Status, search (debounced), and assignee controls sync to URL params. PASS
- Bookmark/deep-link loading applies expected filters. PASS
- Clearing filters strips params and returns to default Open state. PASS

Quality: typecheck + vite build PASS; full E2E suite 170 passed / 4 failed (the 4 failures are pre-existing stale phase4 BUG-2 tests asserting .toBe(500) — unrelated to this feature, flagged for webapp-developer).

Follow-up items raised by the validator (tracked separately, NOT blockers for this feature):
- mqgxk7rj2a (idea): Status filter dropdown shows raw values instead of human-readable labels. Cosmetic.
- Stale phase4 sync tests need updating now that BUG-2 appears fixed.

Feature meets acceptance criteria. Marking validation done.
